title: A Wreck for the Provision
author: Theo Vane
blurb: Freya Amberdale, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
